behavior: Pointer navigation expands or contracts through an actual visible measured rectangle
Keyboard source is captured by the navigation owner and does not animate
Same-scope updates and absent anchors do not animate
Initial render, resize, reduced motion, replacement, hiding, unmount and new input leave no outstanding frame
The renderer reuses bounded vector layouts instead of bitmap captures
retainedCaseChecks: Literal entering, midpoint and leaving rectangle coordinates
No render when stopping an idle scheduler

counterexample.result: A cancelled stale callback appends an extra midpoint render

scope: Deterministic scheduler and geometry plus source integration. Native rendered motion, frame rate and visual acceptance remain manual.
